slices.title: State `steps` beside `task` as the task item's instruction field in SURFACE-task, TOPIC-task-batch and TOPIC-task-seance, and refresh their `upstream` headers to the release the new text was checked against
slices.done_when: In a held sandbox started from the PR checkout, the newest /tmp/omp-llm-request-*.json of a `task.steps=false` session and of a `task.steps=true` session each show the task `<tool … description="replaced">` element plus the `read tool://task/batch` and `read tool://task/seance` results carrying one item-shape sentence that names `steps` as the field replacing `task` when that setting is on and calls the two mutually exclusive (the true session also carrying the ordered-stage rules, the last stage's result being the run's result), the true session's one-item batch dispatch of two `steps` to `task:low` starts without a missing-`steps` rejection, and `bun run check && bun run test` exits 0 on the same checkout.

open_points.point: The three `upstream` headers must name one OMP release, but the contract fixes the 基准 at v18.20.0 (can1357/oh-my-pi@c308970263ae) while this checkout's own dev dependency resolves to 18.20.1, and the inherited decision says to re-check anchors on the release current at PR time.
open_points.input: The `upstream:` line written on the PR's three files, e.g. `pi-coding-agent@18.20.0 src/prompts/tools/task.md, src/task/types.ts, src/task/settings.ts` versus `pi-coding-agent@18.20.1 src/prompts/tools/task.md, src/task/types.ts, src/task/settings.ts`.
outputs: `pi-coding-agent@18.20.0` — 上下文 基准 and 约束 「只按当前发布版（v18.20.0）的说明与 schema 表述」, matching can1357@c308970263ae.
`pi-coding-agent@18.20.1` — ref oh-my-omp/omp-config#320 决策 6863721490 §1 「实施时在 PR 当时的发布版上重新核对锚点」 plus `docs/operations.md:191` 「bump the version in `upstream`」, matching what `bun install` resolved.
open_points.searched: `grep -n '^upstream:' agent/extensions/tool-topics/*.md` (the three in scope say 18.13.2; the newest header in the catalog is 18.18.0), `cat package.json` (every `@oh-my-pi/*` dev dependency is `latest`), `grep -n pi-coding-agent bun.lock`, `grep -rn 'task.steps\|Sequential Task Steps'` over the checkout (no hit).

open_points.point: `TOPIC-task-results.md` still lists `empty \`task\`` among preflight rejections — a sentence that makes `task` the item's instruction field with no mention of `steps`. 范围边界 「不应残留」 forbids exactly that kind of sentence, but 改动文件 names only the three files.
open_points.input: A `task.steps=true` session that reads `tool://task/results` (the topic is indexed under `task`) and then dispatches a batch item that omits `steps` while sending an empty `task`.
outputs: The line stays `empty \`task\``, so a `task.steps=true` session still reads a `task`-only item statement — 不应残留 violated.
The line becomes `empty \`task\` or \`steps\``, so the sentence is right — but the PR edits a fourth file beyond 改动文件.
open_points.producer: agent/extensions/tool-topics/TOPIC-task-results.md:14; the host side it describes is node_modules/@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent/src/task/index.ts:274-296
open_points.searched: `grep -n 'solutionSpace\|`task`' agent/extensions/tool-topics/TOPIC-*.md` (of the task topics outside the three, only `TOPIC-task-results.md:14` calls `task` an item field; `TOPIC-eval-tools.md:55` names the `tools` field, not the instruction field), `grep -rn solutionSpace` over the checkout (no `docs/` page, agent file or command lists item fields), `grep -rn 'task.steps'` over the checkout (no hit).

open_points.point: Row 2's dispatch sentence never names the batch shape, and `task.batch` is on in the sandbox (host default `true`; `agent/config.yml` sets no `batch` key). There a top-level `steps` is rejected as `Top-level \`task\` or \`steps\` is not part of the batch shape` (`src/task/index.ts:312`) and a call without `tasks[]` as `Missing \`tasks\`` (`:341`), so the row's verdict can turn on an error other than the missing-`steps` one it checks.
open_points.input: The task tool call the session's model emits for 「用一次 task 调用派发一个 task:low worker，条目带两步、solutionSpace 写 one fix」: `{ agent: "task:low", steps: [s1, s2], solutionSpace: "one fix" }` at the top level, versus `{ context: "…", tasks: [{ agent: "task:low", steps: [s1, s2], solutionSpace: "one fix" }] }`.
outputs: The batch item is accepted and the spawn starts — row passes as intended.
Rejected with `Missing \`tasks\`. Provide a \`tasks\` array (one subagent per item) with a shared \`context\`.` — row still passes its literal check 「不出现缺 steps 的校验错误」 although nothing started.
Rejected with `Task 1 is missing \`steps\`` — row fails; this is the outcome the change exists to prevent.
open_points.producer: /tmp/ghc/oh-my-omp-omp-config-329/body.md:80 (the acceptance input that leaves the shape open); host preflight at node_modules/@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent/src/task/index.ts:299-345
open_points.searched: `sed -n '34,60p' agent/config.yml` (no `task.batch`), `grep -n 'export const cfgTaskBatch' -A 4 src/task/settings.ts` (default `true`), `grep -n 'function validateSpawnParams' -A 45 src/task/index.ts` (top-level and missing-`tasks` rejections), `grep -n 'taskFields' src/task/types.ts` (one schema for batch items, flat calls and seance).

open_points.point: Surface and topic bodies are static: the catalog is parsed once at factory time and the surface is rendered verbatim inside `<tool name="task" description="replaced">`, with `{{native:…}}` the only substitution. One text therefore has to serve both settings, and the contract does not say how a reader decides which field its own session uses.
open_points.input: The same `<tool name="task" …>` element in a `task.steps=false` session and in a `task.steps=true` session — byte-identical both times; the only per-session signal a reader has is the task tool's parameter entry, which advertises `task` or `steps` (`src/task/types.ts:184`).
outputs: The text names the setting (`task.steps` / `Sequential Task Steps`) as the switch — a reader cannot read its own settings inside a session, since settings are reachable only through the `omp config` CLI (`src/cli/config-cli.ts:302-324`) and no session tool exposes them.
The text says the item's field is whichever of `task`/`steps` the task tool's parameters declare, so the reader decides from the parameter definition it is handed.
open_points.producer: agent/extensions/tool-topics/prompt.ts:166-180 with agent/extensions/tool-topics/catalog.ts:82-102; the host switch it must describe is node_modules/@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent/src/task/types.ts:184
open_points.searched: `read prompt.ts:150-191` (surface rendered verbatim; `{{native}}` is the only substitution), `read catalog.ts:82-152` (parsed once, header stripped before the body is served by `registry.ts:73`), `grep -n 'function handleGet' -A 22 src/cli/config-cli.ts` (settings only via CLI), `grep -rln 'plugin config\|config get\|config set' src/tools/` (no session tool reads settings).

gate_gaps.row: 范围边界 / 不应残留 — `upstream` 头仍只写 18.13.2，未按新文本依据的当前发布版更新来源
gate_gaps.input: `grep -n '^upstream:' agent/extensions/tool-topics/SURFACE-task.md agent/extensions/tool-topics/TOPIC-task-batch.md agent/extensions/tool-topics/TOPIC-task-seance.md` on the PR HEAD. No acceptance row reads these headers, and headers never reach a session (`catalog.ts:82-102` keeps `upstream` out of `Topic`; `registry.ts:73` serves only the body). Row 4's `bun run test` needs only `loadCatalog(…).problems` to be empty (`ci/tool-topics-catalog.test.ts:40-42`), which any single-line value satisfies; biome covers `agent/**/*.ts` only (`biome.json` `files.includes`), not `*.md`.

gate_gaps.row: Row 2 — 「task 的 SURFACE 文本给出 `steps` 的有序阶段写法」
gate_gaps.input: The delta element alone: `jq -r '.messages[]?|strings|select(contains("<tool name=\"task\" description=\"replaced\">"))' $(ls -t /tmp/omp-llm-request-*.json|head -1)`. Row 2's own jq also prints `systemPrompt` (a `string[]`, `src/session/agent-session.ts:7449`), and at `task.steps=true` that block already carries `- steps: ordered stages for one agent; each is sent only after it finishes the previous one, and the last stage's result is returned.` (`src/prompts/tools/task.md:38`), so an unedited SURFACE passes the row as written.

gate_gaps.row: Row 3 — 「task 的 SURFACE 文本仍含 `# Target`/`# Change`/`# Acceptance`，`tool://task/batch` 仍说明 `context` 的用法」
gate_gaps.input: The same `/dump` output: `systemPrompt` already carries `# Target`/`# Change`/`# Acceptance` (`src/prompts/tools/task.md:45`) and `- context: shared (\`# Goal\`, \`# Contract interfaces\`); NEVER repeat per task.` (`task.md:35`), so both checks pass with the old SURFACE and the old batch topic; only the topic's `sourceSession` id/path/ambiguity rules go beyond the native one-liner (`src/prompts/tools/seance-task-guidance.md:1`).

Any row's `/dump` output: no row asserts that the per-step composition the host renders (`First step carries \`# Target\``, `Each step: one \`# Change\` stage`, `Last step adds \`# Acceptance\``, `src/prompts/tools/task.md:39-41`) appears inside the `<tool name="task" …>` element; row 2 checks only ordering, last-result and exclusivity.
